slides.texte_overlay:
hobbies that will make you
dangerously confident

cooking for others

cook one meal a month for friends, even something simple like pasta. hosting puts you in charge of the room, and people always remember who brought them together.

i'm new here

in every new group this month, say "i'm new here, what do i need to know?". owning that you're new makes people want to help you, and hiding it only makes you look lost.

reading out loud

read a page of a book out loud to a friend or partner once a week. hearing your own voice hold attention, line after line, quietly changes how you speak everywhere else.

science breaks

replace one scroll break a day with 5 minutes on a science question: how sleep works, why we dream, what stars are made of. curious people are never short of things to talk about.

science breaks

replace one scroll break a day with 5 minutes on a science question: how sleep works, why we dream. a micro-learning app like the Sophia app makes it easy, and curious people never run out of things to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
helping strangers

give 2 hours a month to helping people you don't know: a food bank, an animal shelter, a beach cleanup. being useful to strangers is one of the fastest ways to feel like you matter.
